title: Story in steps: the first 100 newsletter readers
note: Sample copy written for layout. The numbers are made up for the layout.

slides.headline: I sent four emails to nobody. Then this happened
slides.sub: How a tiny newsletter found its first 100 readers.

slides.headline: Week one was silence
slides.body: I wrote every Sunday for a month. Two subscribers, both related to me. I almost deleted the whole thing.

slides.headline: I asked one reader what they wanted
slides.body: A single reply changed my topic list. I stopped writing for everyone and wrote for one person.

slides.headline: I made it easy to forward
slides.body: Every issue ended with one line: know someone stuck on this? Send it on. Forwards doubled in two weeks.

slides.quote: Write for one reader and the rest will find you.
slides.by: What I wish I had known in week one

slides.label: readers, and every one of them has replied at least once
